production_change: Only the necessary degree>=3 precondition in stereo_centers; the formatter is identical to baseline. Preserve find_sssr preparation and all valid-center branches.
reason: Formatter-only and compound predecessors have failed their fixed gates. Isolate the large parser optimization from numeric formatting and reduce short-operation timing uncertainty with symmetric steady-state instrumentation.
timing_unit: ns per full unfiltered batch = raw elapsed / actual iterations; preserve raw elapsed, iterations, processed records and units
warmup: Same measured mode, at least 500ms; fresh parse/roundtrip objects, prepared write objects. All three arms receive identical settings.
write_semantics: Check rewrites after the same write warmup/time budget. Source before/after snapshots and warmed rewrites must be byte-identical.
data: Exactly the ten 4384-record profiles and corpus hashes of the predecessor, no row filtering or added holdout claims
adoption: Both primary paired CI lower bounds>1; every unrounded source median>=0.99; exact source outcomes and complete frozen classifier/numeral oracles; disclose negative intervals
build: Independent initially empty per-arm targets. Both arms contain the identical probe-only timing patch; all other baseline files must match Git. Verify both actual production compilations and classifier-owner code contrast.
scope: New steady-state throughput protocol, not directly comparable in absolute time or RSS to earlier fixed-three-repeat experiments; not startup/cold-process latency or universal superiority
reruns: One valid timing epoch per profile; no performance-informed reruns or pooling
baseline_update: Use newly merged #981/#986 main before any C samples; earlier sources and results remain unchanged.
